map.还原糖(%) = (F×V₁)/(m×V₂)×100（F 斐林因子 g/mL、V: Reducing sugar (%) = (F×V₁)/(m×V₂)×100 (F is the Fehling factor in g/mL, V₁ the volume of test solution, m the sample, V₂ the volume consumed); sucrose = total sugar − reducing sugar.…
map.F 因子怎么定？: How Is the F Factor Determined?
map.用标准葡萄糖标定斐林试液，得每 mL 相当于多少 g 葡萄糖，随试剂批号变化。: Standardize the Fehling solution with standard glucose to get how many grams of glucose each mL is equivalent to; this varies with the reagent lot.
map.总糖为何高？: Why Is the Total Sugar High?
map.总糖经酸水解把蔗糖/淀粉转还原糖后测定，含还原糖与水解糖，故≥还原糖。: Total sugar is measured after acid hydrolysis converts sucrose/starch into reducing sugars, so it includes both the reducing sugars and the hydrolyzed sugars and is always at least the reducing sugar value.
